screen.comment: Rules v2.1: one open experiment position; max premium = risk_cap_pct of fund_value (stepdown_cap_pct while fund_value < stepdown_below_fund); 60-180 DTE; |delta| 0.35-0.55; stop -50% / target +100% / time stop at half the DTE at entry; calls only (no puts on good firms); Quantfolio index verdict Buy/Buy on weakness required.

pool_rule: Quantfolio_Index.csv: score >= 20 and forensic_severity != KILL (rebuilt by tools/build_pool.py)
overlay_rule: pool members whose Quantfolio verdict is Buy / Buy on weakness, with add_level; screen.csv overlay=Y means verdict Buy AND spot <= add_level AND every numeric rule; a null add_level means not tradable until scored
